diImage.title: Transformed Image
diImage.description: An image with DI transformations included.

image.title: Base Image
image.description: The base image to apply DI transformations to.

crop.title: Crop
crop.description: The crop rectangle to apply, in % scale.

poi.title: Point of Interest
poi.description: The point of interest, in % scale.

fliph.title: Horizontal Flip
fliph.description: Whether the image should be horizontally flipped

flipv.title: Vertical Flip
flipv.description: Whether the image should be vertically flipped

aspectLock.title: Crop Aspect Ratio
aspectLock.description: The aspect ratio to use when resizing the crop rectangle, eg: 4:3. Use 'none' to unlock aspect.

query.title: DI Query String
query.description: A query string baked with all the above parameters.

srcWidth.title: Source Width
srcWidth.description: Intrinsic width of the source image in pixels (from DI metadata). Written by the extension so consumers can reserve layout space without a second call.

srcHeight.title: Source Height
srcHeight.description: Intrinsic height of the source image in pixels (from DI metadata). Written by the extension so consumers can reserve layout space without a second call.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio (width / height) of the delivered image: the crop rectangle when a crop is active, otherwise the source image. Bind directly to CSS aspect-ratio to avoid layout shift (CLS).
